naming.title: Tobacco Vanilla
naming.name_meaning: Names its own two poles — the leaf and the pod
naming.subtitle: Smoky Gourmand Extrait

descriptions.headline: It speaks of low amber light, and long autumn nights.
descriptions.summary: A deep tobacco-vanilla scent defined by warmth, stillness, and quiet intensity.
descriptions.story: Tobacco Vanilla unfolds with smoky tobacco leaves kissed by exotic spices, melting into clouds of creamy vanilla and velvety cacao. Imagine wrapping yourself in the scent of a grand, fireside library where time slows and every breath feels like an invitation. It speaks of low amber light, and long autumn nights — a fragrance that doesn't just linger in the air, but in the memories it creates.
descriptions.pullquote: A fragrance that doesn't just linger in the air, but in the memories it creates.
descriptions.persona: Unhurried and interior. Prefers a small room, a long evening, and no need to fill the silence.
best_for: Anyone who wants a vanilla with smoke in it
descriptions.voice_register: The most literary of the four. Long sentences, sensory compounding, place-and-time imagery (fireside library, autumn nights).

sillage.distance: Fills a room for the first hours, then holds close through the night
